quarterly_data.signal: Coherent 10-K: during fiscal 2026 Coherent announced the expansion of its Sherman, Texas manufacturing facility (expanding indium phosphide capacity to address increased customer demand and an industry-wide shortage) and received a $50 million preliminary memorandum of terms under the CHIPS and Science Act to support the Sherman expansion.
